```{r}
# install.packages("remotes")
# library(remotes)
#remotes::install_github("b-rodrigues/diffindiff")
library(diffindiff)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

ck1994 <- njmin

# explore the ducmentation by running: ? njmin
#View(ck1994)
```

```{r}
table(ck1994$state, ck1994$observation)
# you can explore the data in a bunch of more ways
```

```{r}

ck1994$empfte <- ck1994$empft + 0.5 * ck1994$emppt + ck1994$nmgrs
summary(ck1994$empfte)
```

```{r}
ck1994 %>%
  group_by(state, observation) %>%
  summarize(mean_empfte = mean(empfte, na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r}
ggplot(ck1994, aes(x = wage_st, fill = factor(state))) +
  geom_histogram(position = "dodge", bins = 30) +
  facet_wrap(~ observation) +
  labs(title = "Histogram of Starting Wages by State and date",
       x = "Starting Wage",
       y = "Count",
       fill = "State")
```

```{r}
ck1994 <- ck1994 %>%
  mutate(
    post = ifelse(observation == "November 1992", 1, 0),
    treat = ifelse(state == "New Jersey", 1, 0),
    interaction = post * treat
  )

did_model <- lm(empfte ~ post + treat + I(post * treat), data = ck1994)
summary(did_model)
```
